title: Line up the columns
description:
Write `std::string row(std::string_view name, double price)` that formats one line of a price list:

- the name, left-aligned in a column 12 characters wide,
- the price, right-aligned in a column 8 wide, with exactly two decimals.

```
Coffee          3.50
Sandwich       12.00
```

Build it in a `std::ostringstream` with the manipulators from `<iomanip>`: `std::left`, `std::right`, `std::setw`, `std::fixed`, `std::setprecision`. Remember that `setw` applies only to the very next thing printed.
unitTests:
TEST("pads both columns") { CHECK_EQ(row("Coffee", 3.5), "Coffee          3.50"); CHECK_EQ(row("Sandwich", 12.0), "Sandwich       12.00"); }
TEST("always 20 characters for ordinary values") { CHECK_EQ(row("X", 0.999).size(), 20u); CHECK_EQ(row("X", 0.999), "X               1.00"); }
lessonTitle: Streams In Depth — istream, ostream, stringstream
